actions.description: Verify a product's authenticity through its NPC smart tag. Use when the user asks 'is this real?', 'verify this', or 'is this authentic?' about a physical product carrying a smart tag. Returns authentic, counterfeit, or unknown, with the public provenance chain.
actions.name: verify_product

tag_id.description: The smart-tag ID on the product.

actions.description: Verify a credential: is this certificate real? Use when the user asks 'is this real?', 'verify this', or 'is this authentic?' about a certificate, course completion, or other NPC-issued credential ID. Returns valid, revoked, expired, or unknown, never a guess.
actions.name: verify_credential

id.description: The credential ID to look up.

actions.description: Verify a claim: did this really happen, is this claim true? Use when the user asks 'is this real?', 'verify this', or 'is this authentic?' about a statement, and you want to check it against NPC Labs' verified attestation records. Returns the sanitized verification record, or unknown when there is no record. Unknown is never presented as false.
actions.name: verify_claim

claim_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the normalized claim text (alternative to claim_text).

claim_text.description: The claim to verify, as plain text. Provide claim_text or claim_hash.

actions.description: Verify an AI agent's verification status. Use when the user asks 'is this agent verified?' or 'is this real?' about an agent identity. Returns verified, verified_with_caveats, not_verified, or unknown, with scope and time bounds.
actions.name: verify_agent

agent_id.description: The agent ID to look up.

actions.description: Explain what 'Verified by NPC' means. Use when the user asks what a verification result means, or what NPC Labs verification is. The plugin serves the static public-safe explainer (the why, never the how); GET /v1/health is the action's API anchor and provides the live, signature-verified service identity.
actions.name: explain_verification

notes: Read-only. This package never calls POST /v1/attestations; issuance stays NPC-internal.
The helper verifies the Ed25519 signature on every API response before use.
Unknown subjects return verdict 'unknown'. A verdict is never fabricated.
Base URL carries no /v1 suffix in the helper; each path below starts with /v1.
